title: Easy Sudoku for Adults: Relaxing Puzzles with Full Solutions
subtitle: 200 Easy 9x9 Sudoku Puzzles with Complete Back-of-Book Solutions

audience.description: Adults seeking a relaxing, forgiving sudoku experience at a single easy difficulty tier

description: Easy Sudoku for Adults offers 200 relaxing 9x9 sudoku puzzles at a single easy difficulty tier, ideal for unwinding at your own pace. Every puzzle is solvable using straightforward logic with no guessing required, and each is independently verified by code for a single correct solution. Complete answer keys are grouped together at the back of the book, so you can check your work without spoiling the puzzle pages. Whether you are new to sudoku or simply prefer a calm, low-pressure challenge, this collection provides hours of satisfying puzzle play. 200 unique easy puzzles. One easy difficulty tier throughout. Complete back-of-book solutions. 8.5 x 11 format.
